scenario_description:
Objective: Drive the SeaTac rental van from the airport garage to Tacoma’s morning secure receiving window with the sealed hand-carry portfolio kept with him.
Emerging Need: The exit attempt begins when the paid Oversize Gate 2 session starts, then the barrier faults with the van held inside the lane and no attendant call available.
Decision Context: Recovery depends on matching the stalled gate evidence with stored airport parking release rules and existing trip identifiers before the remote-release queue closes.
Consequence: If the blockage is not helped during that short queue window, the same drive attempt cannot reach the receiving dock in time.
